title: Curse of the Lich
description: The tracked six-player campaign. Every encounter below is played from its log, CombatLogs/<id>.json, prepared with: python -m Combat.Tools.prepare_encounters

encounters.title: Ashelm Church
encounters.description: The accursed ambush at the church: three groups of five Accursed and one group of three.

encounters.title: Goblin Scouting Party
encounters.description: A goblin scouting party, with Greypaw fighting alongside the party.
encounters.difficulty: Balanced for three level 3 players (Edmund, Clover, Kivi).

encounters.title: Goblin Warband Ambush
encounters.description: A goblin warband with hexers and worgs ambushes the party; Greypaw fights alongside them.
encounters.difficulty: Moderate for the full party (6x level 4): 2500 XP, 2300 net of Greypaw.

encounters.title: Wrath of Durmor
encounters.description: The Manifestation of Durmor and the Goblin King with their goblins; Greypaw fights alongside the party.
encounters.difficulty: High for the full party (6x level 4): 3200 XP, 3000 net of Greypaw.

encounters.title: Black Tongues Skirmish
encounters.description: Two Common Cultists with two Accursed.

encounters.title: Yellow Capes Patrol
encounters.description: Marshal Virel with two Yellow Cape Enforcers.

encounters.title: Black Tongues Ritual
encounters.description: The Priest of the Black Tongues with an Accursed Brute, an Accursed Warden and a group of five Accursed.

encounters.title: Yellow Capes' Last Stand
encounters.description: Garron the Kindly and Ser Caldus, the Vow of Silence.

monsters.name: Ser Caldus - The Vow of Silence

encounters.title: The Mouth That Walks
encounters.description: The Mouth That Walks and the Cantor of the Black Choir, with two Accursed.
